name: Mechanized Production
oracle_text:
Enchant artifact you control
At the beginning of your upkeep, create a token that's a copy of enchanted artifact. Then if you control eight or more artifacts with the same name as one another, you win the game.

needs.what: the verification sandbox (verify.build_sandbox / _own_board) needs an artifact you control for a card whose mandatory Aura target is 'artifact you control' -- a swap like swap_in_artifact_body or an added prop, as graveyard_spell_props does for graveyard targets. The DSL already spells the whole card: Aura with targets [{id: enchanted, kind: permanent, selector: {zone: battlefield, controller: you, types: [Artifact]}}]; a triggered ability on {event: upkeep, controller: you} with effects copy_permanent {objects: {attached: true}} then if {cmp: >=, left: {most_sharing_a_name: {objects: {zone: battlefield, controller: you, types: [Artifact]}}}, right: {const: 8}} then win_game {player: you}
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The sandbox board's two creatures are non-artifacts and its 30 lands are basics, so 'Enchant artifact you control' has no legal target, the Aura cannot be cast (601.2c, 303.4a) and gate 4 rejects it as 'not playable in the sandbox'. swap_in_artifact_body only fires for a non-artifact card whose toughness counts your artifacts. Relaxing the target to any controller or making it optional would describe a different card
